paper_title: FreqKV Frequency Domain Key-Value Compression for Efficient Context   Window Extension
caption: : Perplexity evaluation on the validation set of PG-19 with different retaining ratios.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the perplexity values obtained during validation for a model with varying retaining ratios. The x-axis, labeled “Evaluation Context Length,” displays a linear scale ranging from 2K to 64K, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 4K. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity,” is also linear, with values ranging from approximately 7.7 to 8.2. A blue line, marked with circular markers, represents the perplexity at a retaining ratio of 0.25, beginning at a value of approximately 8.0 and decreasing to approximately 7.8. A orange line, marked with circular markers, represents the perplexity at a retaining ratio of 0.25, starting at a value of approximately 7.8 and decreasing to approximately 7.7. A green line, marked with circular markers, represents the perplexity at a retaining ratio of 0.5, initially at a value of approximately 8.0 and decreasing to fall around 7.7. A light green line represents the perplexity at a retaining ratio of 0.75, starting at a value of approximately 8.0 and decreasing to a value of approximately 7.8.
